手机和电脑连接到可互通的同一局域网，在手机开发者选项中开启无线调试。: Connect your phone and computer to the same local network and enable Wireless debugging in Developer options on your phone.
在手机选择“使用二维码配对设备”，扫描下方二维码。: On your phone, select Pair device with QR code and scan the code below.
生成二维码后，使用手机扫描即可配对: Generate a QR code, then scan it with your phone to pair
在手机选择“使用配对码配对设备”，保持 6 位码弹窗打开，然后选择下面的设备。: On your phone, select Pair device with pairing code. Keep the six-digit code dialog open, then select your device below.
请核对手机配对页的 IP 地址: Check the IP address on your phone's pairing screen
自动发现暂不可用，可使用手动连接: Discovery is unavailable. You can connect manually.
正在查找设备，请打开手机的配对码页面…: Searching for devices. Open the pairing code dialog on your phone…
配对码仅用于本次配对，不会保存。: The code is only used for this pairing and is not saved.
未发现设备？请检查网络隔离、防火墙或 VPN，也可切换到手动连接。: No devices found? Check network isolation, firewall, or VPN settings, or switch to Manual connection.
所选设备已停止配对，请重新打开手机配对码页面并选择设备: The selected device stopped pairing. Reopen its pairing code dialog and select it again.
二维码已过期，请生成新的二维码: The QR code expired. Generate a new one.
配对服务无效，请重新选择发现的设备: Invalid pairing service. Select a discovered device again.
无法自动发现设备，请检查 ADB 的 mDNS 支持或使用手动输入: Unable to discover devices. Check ADB mDNS support or enter the address manually.
设备配对服务已变化，请重新打开手机配对码页面并选择设备: The device's pairing service changed. Reopen its pairing code dialog and select it again.
已有扫码配对流程，请先取消或等待完成: A QR pairing session is already active. Cancel it or wait for it to finish.
无法生成配对二维码，请重试: Unable to generate the pairing QR code. Try again.
已停止连接流程；已建立的配对授权请在手机中检查: Connection stopped. Check your phone for any pairing authorization already granted.
请使用手机无线调试中的扫码入口扫描二维码: Scan the QR code from Wireless debugging on your phone
多个地址响应同一二维码，请刷新二维码并只扫描一台手机: Multiple addresses responded to this QR code. Generate a new code and scan it with one phone.
配对未完成，请检查手机配对记录，并重新获取配对码或二维码: Pairing was not confirmed. Check your phone's paired devices and get a new code or QR code.
配对成功，但未能确认设备身份；请使用手机无线调试页的连接端口手动连接: Paired, but device identity could not be confirmed. Connect manually using the connection port on your phone's Wireless debugging page.
配对成功，正在发现并验证无线连接: Paired. Discovering and verifying the wireless connection.
配对成功，无线连接已验证，设备可用: Paired and connected. The device is ready.
配对成功，但无线连接未就绪；请检查网络，或使用手机无线调试页的连接端口手动连接: Paired, but the wireless connection is not ready. Check the network or connect manually using the connection port on your phone's Wireless debugging page.
等待手机扫描二维码，完成配对并验证无线连接: Wait for a phone to scan the QR code, then pair and verify the wireless connection
配对 {0}，随后自动发现并验证无线连接: Pair {0}, then discover and verify the wireless connection
配对后会自动尝试连接。取消配对需在手机的无线调试设置中选择“忘记”。: A connection is attempted after pairing. To revoke pairing, select Forget in Wireless debugging on your phone.
